about: The Workbench icons of the Nikwi drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art is upstream's own icon (nikwi.ico, WTFPL). Nikwi-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, Nikwi.info beside the program. ReadMe.info is also copied for upstream's readme and the licence; Folder.info for the manual.
